components.name: Primary Button

narrative.northStar: The bright pantry, lit by a real scanner sign.
narrative.overview: OffMenu opens with the original animated blue-bracket, white-glass barcode-bowl sign centred on an almost-black signboard. The sign and the motto “From product to pantry to plate” share the full opening viewport. The kitchen fills the viewport in daylight green or dark evergreen. The identity feels like a practical kitchen tool that happens to have a luminous after-hours window, never a generic grocery template.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width household panes in daylight green and dark evergreen.
Home-green type, warm paper layers and a pale-coral landing action.
The original animated blue-bracket, white-glass barcode-bowl sign is the product mark everywhere a logo appears.
Motion is purposeful: the sign energises once, its steam only moves while visible, and every reduced-motion path is still and complete.

rules.name: The Green-First Rule
rules.body: The default light surface is the visible green canvas; a neutral cream or near-white page background is not an OffMenu substitute.

rules.name: The Work-First Type Rule
rules.body: Let application language remain direct and readable; the sign carries the theatre.

rules.name: The Sign Owns the Glow Rule
rules.body: The full animated sign belongs only to the landing stage. Kitchen, account and navigation surfaces use the compact static SVG mark; work surfaces communicate hierarchy with tone, border and quiet elevation.

dos: Do use the visible green canvas as the default light environment.
Do use the original neon barcode-bowl sign anywhere a logo or branded identity is needed.
Do keep controls explicit, high-contrast and comfortably tappable.
Do give the neon sign a dark stage when it needs to glow, while keeping routine product work calm in both themes.
donts: Don't let the light background drift into cream, off-white or ambiguous near-white.
Don't replace the logo with the former boxed mark, a barcode tile, emoji or generic food icon.
Don't spread neon glow or continuous animation across ordinary task UI.
Don't remove the reduced-motion, offscreen-pause or material-fallback behavior from the sign.
